body.title: Why a starter instead of building from scratch

body.text: Agents can build any element from scratch, but that takes professional expertise, time and money.
A starter lets you launch an MVP right away and see what is worth developing and what to drop.

items: The project's agent finds a task that none of your elements solves.
The Fractera store proposes a starter and explains why it fits.
You decide whether to take it. A purchase goes only through your own payment window.
The core installs the starter as a new element, and every element of the project can use it.

body.text: Fractera Market sells tools for a fast start, not ready-made cases.
Fractera does not guarantee that a starter will solve your task in every case. Before buying, study the starter's page and the report that comes with it.
Push the starter you bought to your own GitHub repository and keep developing it.
Once it is noticeably better, you can sell it through the Fractera marketplace.
